findings.summary: The frozen baseline promotes 23 food-item arrays to official ingredients, but no restaurant-issued allergen/ingredient document was found. Toast is restaurant-linked, incomplete, and supports only narrow named-ingredient positives; it cannot support complete arrays, negatives, or cross-contact conclusions.

Luna omitted current product Gazpacho and missed additional Toast rows New York and Seard Tuna Special. Its S2 product inventory also represents every product with the same surface ID as its presentation ID.
Luna missed seven official Food & Drink/menu surfaces. Their content is image-backed or otherwise only partially extractable, so the current restaurant menu boundary remains incomplete.
Braised Pork Shank is present in Luna's current catalog and a recent Toast crawl but absent from the re-opened live Toast page; current state is not resolved.
